blocks.title: The Operator
blocks.body: This archive belongs to one person. They work inside a real manufacturing business during standard hours. At night, the same problems get dragged into a different kind of lab.
Static does not mean dead. It means controlled, fast, portable, and harder to break.

blocks.title: Current Situation
blocks.body: The archive is active. More fragments will surface. Check back.
